cases.notes: Already-settled Promise.resolve; ComponentizeJS 0.21.0 also synchronously drives an already-settled Promise-returning export to completion (documented behavior; see provenance.componentizejs).
Genuine async function; the fulfilled value requires more than one js::RunJobs pass through the microtask queue (nested awaits).

Duck-typed thenable (not a real Promise instance); resolve_promise_like normalizes it via JS::NewPromiseObject + JS::ResolvePromise, reusing the engine's own PromiseResolve semantics rather than hand-rolling a `.then()` call.
Settles via a queued setTimeout (macrotask/async task), not a microtask; exercises EventLoop::pump_until_promise_settled draining api::AsyncTask::select, not just js::RunJobs.
Promise.resolve of a nested typed record, confirming the settled value re-enters the normal typed/JSON result conversion path unchanged.
